description: Free. Call FIRST when the person asks what Ania does, how to start, or seems to think Ania only makes videos or only avatars. Ania does all of this from the chat: create talking avatars (from a photo, mascot or character), CLONE THE USER’S OWN VOICE, make narrated videos with their avatar and their voice (Ania Studio), put the avatar on their screen with Ania Player, custom wake words, and a marketplace with free avatars. Returns the menu to show; relay it and ask where to start.
